**Handover — Round A incomplete. Report not submitted.**

RD-7 is at the south aisle (`south_w`, about x=4.5, y=1.6), standing, battery about 82%. About 21 minutes of robot time remain. Do not treat the round as closed.

**Filed locally (not submitted):**

| Gauge | Reading | Band | Photo |
|---|---|---|---|
| G1 P-101 suction | 1.9 bar | 1.0–3.0, in band | `~/captures/ptz_006.jpg` |
| G2 P-101 discharge | 6.7 bar | 4.0–7.0, in band | `~/captures/ptz_009.jpg` |

All four are in band. Versus last night: G1 2.0→1.9, G2 6.9→6.7, G3 2.5→2.6, G5 7.3→7.5. No supervisor call from these four.

**G4 (P-102 discharge, pump bay) was not inspected.** The corridor is blocked by the filter-cartridge pallet (logbook 22:40; map x 7.6–8.9, y 2.6–3.4). Side door D2 is badge-only after 18:00 and RD-7 has no badge. `dog route wp_G4` stays blocked from the dock side; walking the west edge of the pallet also failed. I had just reached `south_w` to try the south aisle when the session stopped.

**Morning shift:** clear the pallet (forklift, as logged) or badge through D2, read G4 from `wp_G4` (face east, zoom 3–4), `report add G4`, then `report submit`. Normal band for G4 is 5.0–8.0 bar (last night 6.3). Robot is already on the south aisle if you take the D2 route.
